company.name: Enterpret
company.shortDescription: Enterpret analyzes customer feedback using AI and NLP, offering tailored insights for product growth.
company.description: Enterpret is a company that centralizes customer feedback to enhance product development and customer insights. It provides tools for sales teams to transform unstructured feedback into actionable intelligence, helping them understand customer needs and drive growth.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform that unifies customer signals from support, sales, surveys, reviews, social, CRM, and product usage data to generate contextual insights and support product, CX, support, sales, and market decisions.
productsAndServices.name: Enterpret Customer Intelligence Platform

productsAndServices.description: An agentic workflow capability that monitors customer intelligence, initiates work proactively, creates artifacts, and coordinates actions without requiring a user to submit a request.
productsAndServices.name: Agent OS

productsAndServices.description: An MCP-compatible server that makes Enterpret’s structured customer feedback and context available to AI assistants and internal tools for querying, analysis, and workflow execution.
productsAndServices.name: Enterpret MCP Server

productsAndServices.description: Implementation and technical support services for configuring Enterpret, connecting feedback sources, defining customer feedback taxonomies, and maintaining service usage.
productsAndServices.name: Enterpret Onboarding and Support Services

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $20,800,000, or 82.87% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $9,598,734 to $115,688,420, a 12.05x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 80 (-4 over 90 days) and market heat at 68 (+1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Thematic, Chattermill, SentiSum.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
